{{Youmay|the spacer|the [[Indigo (Mandalorian)|Mandalorian]] or the [[Nell Indigo|mercenary]] of the same name}}
'''Indigo''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who made a living by running [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to colonists and settlers in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], during the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].
